decision.explanation: Document D1S4 explicitly states that 'String Quintet No. 2 in G major, Op. 111, is a work by Johannes Brahms published in 1890.' Document D2S5 also directly supports this claim by stating 'String Quintet No 2 in G major, Op 111 composer Johannes Brahms (1833-1897) 1890;' which confirms the same attribution. In contrast, documents D3S3-D3S4 and D4S2-D4S11 refer to String Quintet No. 2 by Ludwig van Beethoven and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, respectively, but these refer to different composers and different works with the same title. Since the question asks specifically for the composer of 'String Quintet No. 2,' and the original context clearly identifies Johannes Brahms as the composer of this specific work, only his name is retained.
